scope: Home Village troop and spawned-unit movement

source.claim: The reference describes the displayed movement-speed unit, its internal 12.5x value, and the resulting approximation of eight displayed units per tile per second.

implementation.applies_to: all mobile entities constructed from immutable GameData
implementation.snapshot_restore: Rebases the serialized entity movement rate from immutable GameData so historical snapshots receive the calibrated rule without changing their schema.

uncertainty: Supercell has not published an equivalent current Home Village unit-conversion specification in the frozen source set. This is a documented secondary calibration, not an official exact-client timing proof.
